title: Partial Repayment Credit on Pocketwire Advance Late Fees
content:
**Clause.** The share of the Pocketwire Advance's principal already repaid is its principal less the unpaid principal, divided by its principal. When that share is at least 0.50, the late fee is multiplied by 0.8; when it is at least 0.30 but below 0.50, the late fee is multiplied by 0.9; when it is below 0.30, no collection factor applies to the late fee.

**Terms.**

- The advance's principal is the principal of the line's most recent advance.
- The unpaid principal is the principal disbursed on the line less the part of its repayments and waivers left after all of its booked fees are covered, never below zero.
- The multiplier acts on the late fee of the period as the unpaid principal multiplied by the weekly rate gives it, before that late fee is rounded.

## Ladder

| Share of the advance's principal already repaid | Late fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| 0.50 or more | 0.8 |
| 0.30 to below 0.50 | 0.9 |
| Below 0.30 | No multiplier |

## Cases (hypothetical advance of 200.00, the line's only advance)

| Unpaid principal | Share repaid | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| 90.00 | 110.00 divided by 200.00, that is 0.55 | 0.8 |
| 100.00 | 0.50 exactly | 0.8 |
| 130.00 | 0.35 | 0.9 |
| 140.00 | 0.30 exactly | 0.9 |
| 150.00 | 0.25 | No multiplier |

Worked figure (hypothetical weekly rate 1.25 percent): with 90.00 unpaid, 90.00 multiplied by 1.25 percent is 1.125, and multiplied by 0.8 it is 0.90 before rounding.
